name: @0xmmo/crew
description: Let Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode agents talk to each other: live shared context and agent-to-agent messaging across sessions.

scripts.send: npm run build && npm test && npm version patch --no-git-tag-version && npm run sync-manifests && git add -A && git commit -m "$(node -p "'v'+require('./package.json').version")" && git tag "$(node -p "'v'+require('./package.json').version")" && npm login && npm publish && git push origin main --tags
scripts.sync-manifests: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const v=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json','utf8')).version;for(const p of ['.claude-plugin/plugin.json','.codex-plugin/plugin.json']){const j=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'));j.version=v;fs.writeFileSync(p,JSON.stringify(j,null,2)+'\n')}console.log('manifests synced to '+v)"
